title: Reduced to 1 star!! Personal size coffee maker.
text:
Reduced to 1 star!! Personal size coffee maker.. *** UPDATED REVIEW REDUCED TO 1 STAR *****

After just 14 cups of coffee, this machine no longer works. It powers on, it heats the water up. And then literally drips one drop into the mug every 90 seconds. It stops after about 20 drops of coffee. The machine is clean, the pods are new there's absolutely no reason for this to have failed. Utter garbage. Avoid!!

****Original review below*****

My husband drinks more coffee than he should, but it makes him happy. I installed this at our shared work station at a volunteer project we're on. It fits in a tiny little space and makes just one real size mug at a time.

It's super simple - add water, insert the kcup pod, press the button on the side and wait. We used three different types of Kcups from three brands including a generic and all three worked great. This is a little slower to heat up than the expensive brand name machines, but it does the job.

product_metadata.title: CHULUX Single Serve Coffee Maker,One Button Operation with Auto Shut-Off for Coffee and Tea with 5 to 12 Ounce,Pink
features: 【SINGLE CUP COFFEE BREWER】 CHULUX single serve coffee maker compatible with 1.0 and 2.0 pod coffee capsules. Also suitable for use ground coffee (Included a black reusable filter ) to create your private cafe at leisure or busy moment.

【A QUICK COFFEE MAKER】800W heating element with rapid brewing technology by blue indicator light flash,also features auto shut-off preventing from overheating,keeping safe and help saving energy.One cup of hot brewed coffee will ready for you within 3mins.

【MUG SIZES COMPATIBLE】The coffee flows out is almost same as the water amount you poured in,ensure every fresh coffee by maximize utilization.The single coffee brewer supports for travel mugs up to 5.3"tall by removing drip tray.

【BUSINESS TRIP AND HOME USE】The compact size is perfect for trip or limited countertop.The portable mini brewer easy to carry anywhere,friendly for office,kitchen,guest room,hotel and RV. But only feasible for 120V voltage within 6000feet altitude.

【EASY TO CLEAN】BPA-FREE material for water tank and piercing needle. Detachable filter basket and drip tray can be removed and washed directly. A easy clean method by pressing button after adding in water and vinegar.
